title: privacyassay-summary/1.1
description: On-device fingerprint exposure result from the CLI or in-page export. Unknown readings receive no credit. The CLI uses strongest/exposedStrong/readingsTotal; the page uses cappedBy/topLeaks/counts. readingsHidden excludes unknown readings.

version.description: PRIORS catalog version the score was computed against

score.description: Weighted observed masking, variation or unavailable APIs. Unknown readings remain in the denominator without credit. For incomplete results this is a lower bound, not a privacy grade.

randomizer.description: Informational indication of a randomizing strategy; not proof of unlinkability.

crossSite.description: Two-origin cross-site result, or null when it was not obtained. Both producers populate it: the in-page two-origin test, and the CLI, which serves 127.0.0.1 and localhost from one handler and waits for the page to finish the comparison. A null here is never a zero - it means not measurable, and crossSiteNote says why.

recognizedOnSecondSite.description: Null: this test does not establish whether a tracker recognizes the browser.

crossSiteNote.description: CLI only, and only when crossSite is null: why the two-origin figure is absent (the page's own failure text, "not measurable", or "skipped (--no-cross)").

runs.description: Number of runs when --runs N>1; the reported score is the median

generated.description: In-page only: ISO 8601 timestamp of the run

browser.description: In-page only: the browser and add-ons the tool identified, or 'not identified'

cappedBy.description: In-page only: the heaviest reading still shown. Same value the CLI calls 'strongest'

topLeaks.description: In-page only: strong readings still shown. Same value the CLI calls 'exposedStrong'

handedOver.description: In-page only: every shown surface, heaviest first

counts.description: Reading counts; hidden + exposed + unknown equals total. Unknown is never counted as hidden.

complete.description: False when any requested scored reading is unknown; grade I means incomplete.

coverage.description: Percentage of requested readings with an established outcome.

upperBound.description: Maximum hidden percentage if all unknown readings were protected. Score is the lower bound.
